in_sanskrit.name: Kanaga
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Majestic, Beautiful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kanaga एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kānaka' meaning 'yellow'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Kānaka-Durga is depicted as a form of Durga, symbolizing beauty, grace, and power.

in_marathi.name: Kanaga
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanaga हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kānaka' meaning 'yellow'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Kānaka-Durga is depicted as a form of Durga, symbolizing beauty, grace, and power.

in_bengali.name: Kanaga
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Majestic, Beautiful
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kanaga একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kānaka' meaning 'yellow'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Kānaka-Durga is depicted as a form of Durga, symbolizing beauty, grace, and power.
